description.text: Type Elementary level (Level 1-5) Internediate level (Level 6-8) Advanced level (Level 9-11) Afternoon Class of Chinese Language Preparatory class Time Schedule 1.Morning classes: 8:00-11:30 (Monday to Friday) 20 academic hours a week, approximately 20 weeks a semester 2.Afternoon classes: 14:00-16:30 10 academic hours a week, approximately 20 weeks a semester 3.Prelliminary course 8:00-11:30 (Monday to Friday), 14:00-16:30 (3 times a week) 30 academic hours a week, approximately 20 weeks a semester Fees 28,000 RMB/year 3,000 RMB/month 80 RMB/academic hour if less than a month

duration.text: The Chinese Language Class at Beijing Sport University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Photocopy of Guarantee Letter(shandong) A Guarantee Letter (click to have a look at the sample) from your school, the education agency or consulting company to prove you are in good conduct is compulsory. Click here to download the template and seal it, and then upload the photocopy through SICAS.
